newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian shares rise on industrial gains.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian shares rise on industrial gains.

text.p: Shares on Jordan's stock exchange rose slightly on Monday in quiet trade bolstered by institutional interest in a handful of industrial firms, brokers said.
The official Amman Financial Market 60-share index rose 0.35 percent to 153.77 points in turnover of 449,000 dinars ($634,000).
Jordan Phosphate Mines, which is heavily weighted on the AMF index, led the way with a four percent rise to 3.40 dinars in trade worth a relatively light 4,000 dinars.
Jordan Cement Factories rose 0.02 dinars in turnover of 11,000 dinars and Jordan Petroleum Refineries rose 0.04 dinars to 10.00 dinars.
Rising shares outnumbered fallers by 17 to eight, with another 14 trading but closing unchanged.
Middle East Investment Bank, the busiest stock of the day, rose 0.01 dinars to 1.15 dinars in trade worth 229,000 dinars ($323,000).
But other heavily traded shares, including Unified Company for Organising Land Transport, Livestock and Poultry and Arabian Seas Investment all eased.
The private Pearl Investable Index of the 45 best performing shares on the exchange rose 0.26 percent to 81.57 points.
